s0401.literal: First year of Zhidawu, spring, first month, xinyou new moon: a partial amnesty was granted to censorate detainees charged with corruption; punishment was limited to confiscation of illicit gains and dismissal from office.
s0401.idiomatic: First year of Zhidawu, spring, first month, xinyou new moon: a partial amnesty was granted to censorate detainees charged with corruption; punishment was limited to confiscation of illicit gains and dismissal from office.

s0402.literal: On guihai day the privy council was ordered to dispatch eighteen thousand five hundred troops of the Six Guards for construction labor at Onggachatu.
s0402.idiomatic: On guihai day the privy council was ordered to dispatch 18,500 troops of the Six Guards for construction labor at Onggachatu.

s0403.literal: On jiazi day central secretariat pingzhang Ashabuhua was appointed right chancellor and acting censor-in-chief.
s0403.idiomatic: On jiazi day central secretariat pingzhang Ashabuhua was appointed right chancellor and acting censor-in-chief.

s0404.literal: On bingyin day, acceding to the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat's request, the mobile Directorate of Waterways was abolished and its affairs placed under the regular offices.
s0404.idiomatic: On bingyin day, acceding to the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat's request, the mobile directorate of waterways was abolished and its affairs placed under the regular offices.

s0405.literal: The Crown Prince's Tent-Equipment Office and Harmony Reception Office were established, both at rank 5a.
s0405.idiomatic: The crown prince's tent-equipment office and harmony reception office were established, both at rank 5a.

s0406.literal: On dingmao day central secretariat right vice chancellor Yekhanijin was made pingzhang and charged with deliberating Shaanxi branch secretariat affairs.
s0406.idiomatic: On dingmao day central secretariat right vice chancellor Yekhanijin was made pingzhang and charged with deliberating Shaanxi branch secretariat affairs.

s0407.literal: On jisi day six routes — Shaoxing, Taizhou, Qingyuan, Guangde, Jiankang, and Zhenjiang — suffered famine; the dead were very numerous; more than four hundred sixty thousand famine households received six dou of rice per month per household; property confiscated from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan under the Central Regency Directorate was sold for three hundred thousand ingots of notes to provide relief.
s0407.idiomatic: On jisi day six routes — Shaoxing, Taizhou, Qingyuan, Guangde, Jiankang, and Zhenjiang — suffered famine; the dead were very numerous; more than 460,000 famine households received six dou of rice per month per household; property confiscated from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan under the Central Regency Directorate was sold for 300,000 ingots of notes to provide relief.

s0408.literal: The wet-nurse's husband Duke of Shouguo Yang Yanjianu was specially appointed Grand Master with Opening of the Office and Equal Honours with the Three Excellencies.
s0408.idiomatic: The wet-nurse's husband Duke of Shouguo Yang Yanjianu was specially appointed grand master with opening of the office and equal honours with the three excellencies.

s0409.literal: On jisi day Burma presented six trained elephants.
s0409.idiomatic: On jisi day Burma presented six trained elephants.

s0410.literal: On xinwei day privy council officials said: "Previously by imperial command the Zhongwei guard troops were placed under the crown prince's establishment; the crown prince told us, 'Shizu established five guards to correspond to the five directions — remove one and it cannot be done.'
s0410.idiomatic: On xinwei day privy council officials said, "Previously by imperial command the Zhongwei guard troops were placed under the crown prince's establishment; the crown prince told us, 'Shizu established five guards to correspond to the five directions — remove one and it cannot be done.'

s0411.literal: Each wing should select ten thousand Han troops and establish a separate guard.
s0411.idiomatic: Each wing should select 10,000 Han troops and establish a separate guard.

s0412.literal: " The Emperor approved; he ordered privy council director Tiemuer Buhua and others to select ten thousand Han troops and establish a separate guard.
s0412.idiomatic: The Emperor approved; he ordered privy council director Tiemuer Buhua and others to select 10,000 Han troops and establish a separate guard.

s0413.literal: On jiaxu day central secretariat officials said: "Those presenting eastern-sea gerfalcons must travel by relay; five hundred horses are insufficient; an edict dispatched Qielie and Yingtong to requisition civilian horses and carts; the Ministry of War requests that relay horses at each station be sent up in succession — not requisitioning would be better.
s0413.idiomatic: On jiaxu day central secretariat officials said, "Those presenting eastern-sea gerfalcons must travel by relay; 500 horses are insufficient; an edict dispatched Qielie and Yingtong to requisition civilian horses and carts; the Ministry of War requests that relay horses at each station be sent up in succession — not requisitioning would be better.

s0415.literal: The Central Regency Directorate's artisan commissionerate was changed to the Splendid Treasures Office, rank 3a.
s0415.idiomatic: The Central Regency Directorate's artisan commissionerate was changed to the Splendid Treasures Office, rank 3a.

s0416.literal: On jimao day the Central Atelier Directorate was promoted to the Central Atelier Directorate, rank 2b.
s0416.idiomatic: On jimao day the central atelier directorate was promoted to the Central Atelier Directorate, rank 2b.

s0417.literal: Prince of Bin Chubo presented six hundred fifteen jin of jade; he was granted one thousand five hundred taels of gold, twenty thousand taels of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes; his followers forty thousand ingots;
s0417.idiomatic: Prince of Bin Chubo presented 615 jin of jade; he was granted 1,500 taels of gold, 20,000 taels of silver, and 10,000 ingots of notes; his followers 40,000 ingots;

s0418.literal: Kuancha, Yesian Bek, and others — two thousand three hundred taels of gold, ten thousand seven hundred taels of silver, thirty-nine thousand one hundred ingots of notes.
s0418.idiomatic: Kuancha, Yesian Bek, and others — 2,300 taels of gold, 10,700 taels of silver, and 39,100 ingots of notes.

s0419.literal: On jiashen day Chuangwu'er was ordered that apart from enthronement grace grants, he was specially granted five hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, and two thousand ingots of notes.
s0419.idiomatic: On jiashen day Chuangwu'er was ordered that apart from enthronement grace grants, he was specially granted 500 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, and 2,000 ingots of notes.

s0420.literal: On wuzi day the crown prince requested that Ashabuhua return to the central secretariat and Tuotuo return to the censorate.
s0420.idiomatic: On wuzi day the crown prince requested that Ashabuhua return to the central secretariat and Tuotuo return to the censorate.

s0421.literal: On jiyou day central secretariat officials said: "Ash Temur requests dispatching Jiaohua to the Hexi region to collect jade; transport of jade sand requires more than forty horses; jade collectors exceed one thousand.
s0421.idiomatic: On jiyou day central secretariat officials said, "Ash Temur requests dispatching Jiaohua to the Hexi region to collect jade; transport of jade sand requires more than 40 horses; jade collectors exceed 1,000.

s0422.literal: We consider this non-urgent labor troubling the people and beg it be stopped.
s0422.idiomatic: We consider this non-urgent labor troubling the people and beg it be stopped.

s0423.literal: " They also said: "Recently the people have scarce food and bandits fill the land; if not strictly suppressed, it will spread.
s0423.idiomatic: They also said, "Recently the people have scarce food and bandits fill the land; if not strictly suppressed, it will spread.

s0424.literal: Envoys should be dispatched to tour; when criminal prisoners are encountered, sentence and dispatch immediately; jointly deliberate with local officials on bandit-suppression strategy; clearly establish rewards and punishments — those who conceal reports of bandits, fail to arrive at assemblies, or fail to capture within deadlines — officials are jointly liable.
s0424.idiomatic: Envoys should be dispatched to tour; when criminal prisoners are encountered, sentence and dispatch immediately; jointly deliberate with local officials on bandit-suppression strategy; clearly establish rewards and punishments — those who conceal reports of bandits, fail to arrive at assemblies, or fail to capture within deadlines — officials are jointly liable.

s0425.literal: " They also said: "Pirates of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat appear and vanish, killing soldiers and civilians.
s0425.idiomatic: They also said, "Pirates of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat appear and vanish, killing soldiers and civilians.

s0426.literal: Those already captured, by regulation should await reporting to close cases; officials should be dispatched jointly by the central secretariat and yeke jarquchi, together with the branch secretariat, regional censorate, pacification commission, and surveillance commission to review that there is no injustice, and execute them in the market.
s0426.idiomatic: Those already captured, by regulation should await reporting to close cases; officials should be dispatched jointly by the central secretariat and yeke jarquchi, together with the branch secretariat, regional censorate, pacification commission, and surveillance commission to review that there is no injustice, and execute them in the market.

s0427.literal: Those not yet captured — supervise and pursue; those who surrender themselves are pardoned and given grain; those who capture accomplices receive added reward.
s0427.idiomatic: Those not yet captured — supervise and pursue; those who surrender themselves are pardoned and given grain; those who capture accomplices receive added reward.

s0428.literal: " An order stated: "Suppressing bandits and securing the people is supremely important; this should be deliberated and implemented immediately.
s0428.idiomatic: An order stated, "Suppressing bandits and securing the people is supremely important; this should be deliberated and implemented immediately.

s0429.literal: " Prince Yesian Temur was enfeoffed as Prince of Ying; the wet-nurse's husband Oghortu was made minister of the interior.
s0429.idiomatic: Prince Yesian Temur was enfeoffed as Prince of Ying; the wet-nurse's husband Oghortu was made minister of the interior.

s0430.literal: Second month, guisi day: the Falconry Office was established as the Renyu Directorate, rank 1a.
s0430.idiomatic: Second month, guisi day: the Falconry Office was established as the Renyu Directorate, rank 1a.

s0431.literal: Right chancellor Tuotuo, remotely appointed left chancellor Tula Temur, and yeke jarquchi Yuelichi were all made directors of the Renyu Directorate.
s0431.idiomatic: Right chancellor Tuotuo, remotely appointed left chancellor Tula Temur, and yeke jarquchi Yuelichi were all made directors of the Renyu Directorate.

s0432.literal: Runing and Guide — two routes — suffered drought and locusts; the people starved; ten thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0432.idiomatic: Runing and Guide — two routes — suffered drought and locusts; the people starved; 10,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0433.literal: On jiawu day one associate director and one co-signatory of the Quanfu Directorate were added each.
s0433.idiomatic: On jiawu day one associate director and one co-signatory of the Quanfu Directorate were added each.

s0434.literal: Yidu, Jining, Banyang, Jinan, Dongping, and Tai'an suffered great famine; Shandong pacification commissioner Wang Zuo was dispatched together with the surveillance commission to verify and provide relief — one hundred two thousand two hundred thirty-seven-odd ingots of notes and nineteen thousand three hundred forty-eight shi of grain.
s0434.idiomatic: Yidu, Jining, Banyang, Jinan, Dongping, and Tai'an suffered great famine; Shandong pacification commissioner Wang Zuo was dispatched together with the surveillance commission to verify and provide relief — 102,237-odd ingots of notes and 19,348 shi of grain.

s0435.literal: On yiwei day central secretariat officials said: "Since Your Majesty's accession, enfeoffing and rewarding princes, sustaining military strength, relieving the people, and special grace grants broadly distributed have emptied the treasury; salt certificates were pre-sold.
s0435.idiomatic: On yiwei day central secretariat officials said, "Since Your Majesty's accession, enfeoffing and rewarding princes, sustaining military strength, relieving the people, and special grace grants broadly distributed have emptied the treasury; salt certificates were pre-sold.

s0436.literal: Now Karakorum, Gansu, Datong, Longxing, both capitals' military grain, all construction, and every supply require more than eight million ingots of notes.
s0436.idiomatic: Now Karakorum, Gansu, Datong, Longxing, both capitals' military grain, all construction, and every supply require more than 8 million ingots of notes.

s0437.literal: In the past when funds ran short, memorials requested disbursing note reserves were submitted.
s0437.idiomatic: In the past when funds ran short, memorials requested disbursing note reserves were submitted.

s0438.literal: We indeed know paper-money policy is not trivial and dare not lightly move it, yet with no alternative, we now beg temporarily to disburse more than seven million ingots of note reserves to cover urgent needs, deferring non-urgent expenditures.
s0438.idiomatic: We indeed know paper-money policy is not trivial and dare not lightly move it, yet with no alternative, we now beg temporarily to disburse more than 7 million ingots of note reserves to cover urgent needs, deferring non-urgent expenditures.

s0439.literal: " The Emperor said: "Your words are correct.
s0439.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Your words are correct.

s0440.literal: For broad grants, regardless of who seeks them, do not conceal and memorialize.
s0440.idiomatic: For broad grants, regardless of who seeks them, do not conceal and memorialize.

s0441.literal: " The Lodging Directorate was promoted to the Lodging Temple, rank 3a.
s0441.idiomatic: The lodging directorate was promoted to the Lodging Temple, rank 3a.

s0442.literal: On bingshen day the Selection-and-Employment Directorate was established, rank 3a, subordinate to the Central Regency Directorate.
s0442.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Selection-and-Employment Directorate was established, rank 3a, subordinate to the Central Regency Directorate.

s0443.literal: Huai'an and other places suffered famine; acceding to the Henan branch secretariat, one hundred thousand Liang-Zhe salt certificates were traded for grain for relief.
s0443.idiomatic: Huai'an and other places suffered famine; acceding to the Henan branch secretariat, 100,000 Liang-Zhe salt certificates were traded for grain for relief.

s0444.literal: On wuxu day three thousand Shangdu guard troops were sent for construction labor at the Onggachatu palace.
s0444.idiomatic: On wuxu day 3,000 Shangdu guard troops were sent for construction labor at the Onggachatu palace.

s0445.literal: On renyin day central secretariat officials said: "Keshik harassed Tanzhou commoners; an edict dispatched men to investigate; those who confessed should receive added punishment; an order said do not inquire.
s0445.idiomatic: On renyin day central secretariat officials said, "Keshik harassed Tanzhou commoners; an edict dispatched men to investigate; those who confessed should receive added punishment; an order said do not inquire.

s0446.literal: We consider this improper; those who have already confessed were first sentenced and dispatched.
s0446.idiomatic: We consider this improper; those who have already confessed were first sentenced and dispatched.

s0447.literal: " The Emperor said: "Wait until their hunt is finished to punish them.
s0447.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Wait until their hunt is finished to punish them.

s0448.literal: " Acceding to the crown prince's request, the crown prince's tutor director was changed to tutor, associate tutor to junior tutor, and directorate judge to assistant.
s0448.idiomatic: Acceding to the crown prince's request, the crown prince's tutor director was changed to tutor, associate tutor to junior tutor, and directorate judge to assistant.

s0449.literal: The Attire Directorate was established, rank 2b.
s0449.idiomatic: The Attire Directorate was established, rank 2b.

s0450.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "The Shaanxi branch secretariat states that Kaicheng Route earlier suffered an earthquake; the people's strength is heavily burdened; rents were remitted for two years; they request remitting this year again.
s0450.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "The Shaanxi branch secretariat states that Kaicheng Route earlier suffered an earthquake; the people's strength is heavily burdened; rents were remitted for two years; they request remitting this year again.

s0452.literal: On jiachen day King Hetong was granted two hundred fifty taels of gold and seven hundred fifty taels of silver.
s0452.idiomatic: On jiachen day King Hetong was granted 250 taels of gold and 750 taels of silver.

s0453.literal: The crown prince's guard command was established; one thousand five hundred troops were dispatched to repair Buddhist temples on Wutai Mountain.
s0453.idiomatic: The crown prince's guard command was established; 1,500 troops were dispatched to repair Buddhist temples on Wutai Mountain.

s0454.literal: An order directed the relevant offices to purchase one mansion to grant to grand councillor Chiyin Temur, costing nineteen thousand four hundred ingots of notes.
s0454.idiomatic: An order directed the relevant offices to purchase one mansion to grant to grand councillor Chiyin Temur, costing 19,400 ingots of notes.

s0455.literal: On dingwei day, acting on grand councillor Yangtou's advice, six palace attendants — Headgear, Garments, Saddles and Trappings, Bathing, Carriages, and Adornment — were established at rank 5, forty-eight posts in all, subordinate to the Attire Directorate.
s0455.idiomatic: On dingwei day, acting on grand councillor Yangtou's advice, six palace attendants — headgear, garments, saddles and trappings, bathing, carriages, and adornment — were established at rank 5, 48 posts in all, subordinate to the Attire Directorate.

s0456.literal: On jiayin day poor people of Karakorum coming from the north were numerous; one hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted to support them; grain was still purchased at Datong, Longxing, and elsewhere for relief, and they were ordered to garrison-farm.
s0456.idiomatic: On jiayin day poor people of Karakorum coming from the north were numerous; 100,000 ingots of notes were granted to support them; grain was still purchased at Datong, Longxing, and elsewhere for relief, and they were ordered to garrison-farm.

s0457.literal: A memorial requested that eunuchs, imperial physicians, yin-yang masters, and musicians not cite regular selection for titular appointments.
s0457.idiomatic: A memorial requested that eunuchs, imperial physicians, yin-yang masters, and musicians not cite regular selection for titular appointments.

s0458.literal: Nets were issued to Karakorum famine victims.
s0458.idiomatic: Nets were issued to Karakorum famine victims.

s0459.literal: On wuwu day Badadasi and others were dispatched to escort the Java envoys home.
s0459.idiomatic: On wuwu day Badadasi and others were dispatched to escort the Java envoys home.

s0460.literal: On jiwei day, because the crown prince was building a Buddhist temple, a Construction Office was established, rank 5.
s0460.idiomatic: On jiwei day, because the crown prince was building a Buddhist temple, a Construction Office was established, rank 5.

s0461.literal: Third month, gengshen new moon: central secretariat officials said: "Prince of Shan Zhuohunan's registered households have scattered; an edict directed the relevant offices to requisition and search.
s0461.idiomatic: Third month, gengshen new moon: central secretariat officials said, "Prince of Shan Zhuohunan's registered households have scattered; an edict directed the relevant offices to requisition and search.

s0462.literal: We deliberated: formerly Ajiji requisitioned lost households; Chengzong worried it would set a precedent and did not permit it.
s0462.idiomatic: We deliberated: formerly Ajiji requisitioned lost households; Chengzong worried it would set a precedent and did not permit it.

s0463.literal: If we requisition now, it will inevitably trouble the people.
s0463.idiomatic: If we requisition now, it will inevitably trouble the people.

s0464.literal: Moreover princes will surely cite many precedents; we beg to set aside the matter.
s0464.idiomatic: Moreover princes will surely cite many precedents; we beg to set aside the matter.

s0466.literal: Also Empress Zhuangsheng's and Prince Huttutu's households had scattered into other prefectures; Aduchi and Tuohuan were granted imperial letters ordering requisition.
s0466.idiomatic: Also Empress Zhuangsheng's and Prince Huttutu's households had scattered into other prefectures; Aduchi and Tuohuan were granted imperial letters ordering requisition.

s0467.literal: The Shaanxi branch secretariat and Zhending and other routes said: "Commoners are all on the state's registers; the envoys now sent arbitrarily seize military households, relay households, registered civilian households, and the like — this is improper.
s0467.idiomatic: The Shaanxi branch secretariat and Zhending and other routes said, "Commoners are all on the state's registers; the envoys now sent arbitrarily seize military households, relay households, registered civilian households, and the like — this is improper.

s0468.literal: " Central secretariat officials reported; the Emperor said: "Their memorial was mistaken; you are to speedily pursue and return them.
s0468.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials reported; the Emperor said, "Their memorial was mistaken; you are to speedily pursue and return them.

s0469.literal: " Prince of Zhennan Lao Zhang was granted five hundred taels of gold, five thousand taels of silver, two thousand ingots of notes, and eight hundred bolts of silks and cloths; Yesian Buhua and Yarixi each two hundred fifty taels of gold, seven hundred fifty taels of silver, and two thousand ingots of notes.
s0469.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Lao Zhang was granted 500 taels of gold, 5,000 taels of silver, 2,000 ingots of notes, and 800 bolts of silks and cloths; Yesian Buhua and Yarixi each 250 taels of gold, 750 taels of silver, and 2,000 ingots of notes.

s0470.literal: On yichou day the moon encroached upon Well.
s0470.idiomatic: On yichou day the moon encroached upon Well.

s0471.literal: Because eight hundred sixty-eight thousand poor households coming from the north relied on official provisions — not a long-term plan — one million five hundred thousand ingots of notes and silks and cloths equivalent to five hundred thousand ingots were granted; Grand Preceptor Yuechicha'er and Grand Tutor Halaqsun were ordered to distribute them and abolish the grain allowances.
s0471.idiomatic: Because 868,000 poor households coming from the north relied on official provisions — not a long-term plan — 1,500,000 ingots of notes and silks and cloths equivalent to 500,000 ingots were granted; grand preceptor Yuechicha'er and grand tutor Halaqsun were ordered to distribute them and abolish the grain allowances.

s0472.literal: Prince Bayihu was granted one hundred fifty taels of gold and seven hundred fifty taels of silver.
s0472.idiomatic: Prince Bayihu was granted 150 taels of gold and 750 taels of silver.

s0473.literal: On dingmao day the Xingsheng Palace was built; fifty thousand ingots of notes and twenty thousand jin of silk were granted.
s0473.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Xingsheng Palace was built; 50,000 ingots of notes and 20,000 jin of silk were granted.

s0474.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the five sacred peaks, four great rivers, famous mountains, and great rivers.
s0474.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the five sacred peaks, four great rivers, famous mountains, and great rivers.

s0475.literal: Prince Babusha was granted five hundred taels of gold and five thousand taels of silver.
s0475.idiomatic: Prince Babusha was granted 500 taels of gold and 5,000 taels of silver.

s0476.literal: The Baiyun sect administrative office was re-established, rank 1b, with three officials.
s0476.idiomatic: The Baiyun sect administrative office was re-established, rank 1b, with three officials.

s0477.literal: On wuyin day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0477.idiomatic: On wuyin day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0478.literal: A Buddhist temple was built south of Dadu.
s0478.idiomatic: A Buddhist temple was built south of Dadu.

s0479.literal: The Jiyong and Ziwu treasuries were established, rank 5a, subordinate to the palace steward's office.
s0479.idiomatic: The Jiyong and Ziwu treasuries were established, rank 5a, subordinate to the palace steward's office.

s0480.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy was promoted to rank 2b; the Bureau of Celestial Observatory to rank 4a.
s0480.idiomatic: The directorate of astronomy was promoted to rank 2b; the bureau of celestial observatory to rank 4a.

s0481.literal: Central secretariat right chancellor and acting pingzhang Ashabuhua was enfeoffed as Duke of Kang.
s0481.idiomatic: Central secretariat right chancellor and acting pingzhang Ashabuhua was enfeoffed as Duke of Kang.

s0482.literal: Gansu branch secretariat right vice chancellor Totoqmu'er was made central secretariat pingzhang and given the added title grand minister of works.
s0482.idiomatic: Gansu branch secretariat right vice chancellor Totoqmu'er was made central secretariat pingzhang and given the added title grand minister of works.

s0483.literal: Prince of Jin's following of five hundred forty-seven persons was granted fifty-two thousand nine hundred sixty ingots of notes;
s0483.idiomatic: Prince of Jin's following of 547 persons was granted 52,960 ingots of notes;

s0484.literal: Prince of Ding Yaqmuqur — one thousand five hundred taels of gold, thirty thousand taels of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes;
s0484.idiomatic: Prince of Ding Yaqmuqur — 1,500 taels of gold, 30,000 taels of silver, and 10,000 ingots of notes;

s0485.literal: Fifty-three guard soldiers — ten thousand six hundred ingots of notes.

s0486.idiomatic: On yimao day the Hanlin Academy and Directorate of Historiography were ordered to compile Veritable Records of Shunzong and Chengzong.

s0487.literal: On renwu day hereditary Celestial Master of Han Zhang Yucai came to court; he was given added rank as Grand Master with Golden Girdle and Purple Insignia and enfeoffed as Duke of Liu.
s0487.idiomatic: On renwu day hereditary Celestial Master of Han Zhang Yucai came to court; he was given added rank as grand master with golden girdle and purple insignia and enfeoffed as Duke of Liu.

s0488.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuxu day: central secretariat officials said: "We request that in accordance with edicts and commands previously issued, appointments not exceed regulations and gifts not be recklessly granted.
s0488.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, wuxu day: central secretariat officials said, "We request that in accordance with edicts and commands previously issued, appointments not exceed regulations and gifts not be recklessly granted.

s0489.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Your words are correct.

s0490.idiomatic: I have repeatedly issued orders to stop it, yet again there is concealment in requests; from now even if there is an order, you are to memorialize again and punish the offense.

s0491.idiomatic: An edict directed granting Yongping Route's salt revenues to Princess Sanggeji; central secretariat officials insisted it was impermissible; this was approved.

s0492.idiomatic: Prince Munan's son was granted 50 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, and 1,000 ingots of notes; the crown prince's falconry office was granted 200,000 ingots of notes.

s0499.idiomatic: On xinhai day privy council officials said, "Each prince uses his own seal-token to travel by relay; envoys come and go incessantly; relay households are exhausted.

s0500.idiomatic: It is fitting to follow the old regulations, measure their horse numbers, and issue imperial letters.
